stories.title: Preseason AP poll reaction: What's next for each Top 25 team
stories.summary: Ohio State opens the year as the top-ranked team, trailed by another Big Ten team, Oregon. The SEC has five teams in the top 10, led by No. 3 Georgia and No. 5 Texas. With the Buckeyes visiting the Longhorns in Week 2, these rankings won't remain set for long.

stories.title: Sources: Jeanie out as Busses sell stake in Lakers
stories.summary: The Buss family has decided to sell its remaining ownership stake in the Lakers, meaning Jeanie Buss will no longer remain governor of the team.

stories.title: Sources: NBA lacks proof Ballmer paid via firms
stories.summary: The NBA has found no evidence showing LA Clippers owner Steve Ballmer funneled money through team sponsors to pay Kawhi Leonard, according to three people with knowledge of discussions between the two sides in recent days.

stories.title: LIV cancels Michigan stop, to end season in Indy
stories.summary: LIV Golf has canceled its individual and team championship in Michigan later this month, meaning this week's event near Indianapolis is the final one of the season.

stories.title: Ohio State, Oregon start 1-2 in AP preseason poll
stories.summary: Ohio State and Oregon were 1-2 in the AP Top 25, giving the Big Ten Conference the top two teams in the preseason rankings for the first time in 65 years.
